jm: Esence A (bez věty o scéně) · Berkana · Opus
pokyn: THE ESSENCE LINE: after the picture, one short line that says which side of the rune this picture shows — its sense in plain words a stranger to runes can grasp. Never a fixed formula. No invented mechanism, no fate. Never tell the seeker what it means for them.
text: Before anything is seen, there is the thin piping of ducklings from under the grass. Then the eider steps out, and the small ones follow her down to the water for the first time. Berkana is the care that goes ahead of something new and holds the pace steady. Could something young in your life, Kuky, be asking for that kind of unhurried keeping?

jm: Esence A (bez věty o scéně) · Hagalaz · Opus
pokyn: THE ESSENCE LINE: after the picture, one short line that says which side of the rune this picture shows — its sense in plain words a stranger to runes can grasp. Never a fixed formula. No invented mechanism, no fate. Never tell the seeker what it means for them.
text: At the bank's edge, the ground that was solid last night is water this morning. Hagalaz is the sudden weather that takes what stood too close. What the river carries off was never held by roots. Kuky, either something near you is being pulled loose, or what remains is simply what was anchored all along.

jm: Esence A (bez věty o scéně) · Gebo · Opus
pokyn: THE ESSENCE LINE: after the picture, one short line that says which side of the rune this picture shows — its sense in plain words a stranger to runes can grasp. Never a fixed formula. No invented mechanism, no fate. Never tell the seeker what it means for them.
text: The trailer rolls down the neighbour's track, and months later a leg of lamb sits wrapped on your step. Gebo is the exchange that keeps no ledger, and still it comes round. Neither of you named a price, yet something passed both ways. There may be something you are giving now without knowing its return, and something offered to you that need not be answered yet.

jm: Esence B (A + čtenář obraz nezná) · Hagalaz · Opus
pokyn: THE ESSENCE LINE: after the picture, one short line that says which side of the rune this picture shows — its sense in plain words a stranger to runes can grasp. The seeker knows only the words of the reading, not the picture behind them: say what the rune means in its own terms, not what happens in the scene. Never a fixed formula. No invented mechanism, no fate. Never tell the seeker what it means for them.
text: Where the bank ends the water begins, and overnight that line moves inland. The river rises and carries off what was built too close to it. Hagalaz is the sudden weather that takes without asking, and leaves the ground changed. Kuky, something near you may be loosening its hold, or it may already be gone downstream.
